title: SentencePiece: A simple and language independent subword tokenizer
before: Subword tokenizers assumed text was already split into words by whitespace.
problem: That assumption fails for Japanese, Chinese, Thai and any language without spaces.
breakthrough: Treat raw text, spaces included, as the input and learn subwords directly from it, reversibly.
why: It made tokenization language-agnostic, which is why multilingual models are practical.
next: Used by T5, Llama and most non-English-first models.
inherits: The tokenizer library much of the field still uses.
